description: This file defines a PHP class UsersViewQuickedit which extends the ViewQuickEdit class, customizing the behavior for the quick edit view of the Users module in SuiteCRM. It specifies a custom footer template and default buttons for the quick edit interface.

classes.name: UsersViewQuickedit
classes.description: A view class extending ViewQuickEdit, providing specialized quick edit functionality for Users, including custom footer template and default buttons.
